note: Description taken from Holmgren's 1910 original description of Eutermes globiceps (in German), including the soldier and worker; alate unknown; type locality San Bernardino, Paraguay (collected by Jordan, Vienna Museum). The original is in German and the BHL scan OCR is only moderate: decimal points are often misread as commas or colons and some measurement digits are blurred; blurred values are not cited. The species was then placed in Eutermes and is now in Nasutitermes.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head large and thick, a perfect circle in dorsal view, the nasus relatively short and thick, conical; frontal outline almost a straight line, with only a weak elevation at the base of the nasus; closest to E. Meinerti from Venezuela but distinctly larger and with a thicker and shorter nasus; alate unknown.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pitch-brown, nasus tip paler; tergites brown, sternites rusty yellow to rusty brown. Head bristled only at the base of the nasus; abdominal tergites rather densely covered with short stiff hairs, with or without marginal bristle rows; sternite hairs longer and with marginal bristle rows. Head large and thick, a perfect circle in dorsal view, nasus relatively short, thick and conical; frontal outline almost a straight line with only a weak elevation at the base of the nasus. Antennae 13-segmented: segment 2 equal to segment 4, segment 3 distinctly longer than segments 2 and 4. Pronotum rather strongly saddle-shaped, anterior margin hardly concave. Measurements (10 heads): head length 1.85—1.95 mm (mostly 1.90—1.95 mm); head width 1.39—1.64 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head brown, the head capsule sutures, frontal marks, anterior margin of the transverse band, genae, postclypeus, antennae and mouthparts yellow; abdominal tergites brown, sternites white-yellow. Head rather densely hairy, the hairs relatively short; abdominal tergites rather densely hairy but without marginal bristle rows, the sternites with bristle rows. Head broadly oval (almost rounded-square); head capsule sutures very distinct; frontal marks long triangular; postclypeus shorter than half its width. Antennae 14-segmented: segment 2 slightly longer than segment 4, segment 3 longer than segment 2. Pronotum not strongly saddle-shaped, anterior margin very weakly wavy. Measurements: body length 6—6.5 mm; head width about 1.46 mm (the head length figure is blurred in the OCR and is not cited).
